tag.description: Published release tag rendered in front of the digest so the workload reference is human-legible. Legibility only: the digest is what Kubernetes resolves and what cosign and admission verify, and it is required alongside this.

ingress.description: The deployment-provider binding point: identifies the only ingress peer allowed to reach the origin. The origin itself is provider-neutral and speaks standard HTTP; swapping edge providers is a values override here, never a template or code edit. Every field is required, so the peer selector can never render with fewer facts than it takes to name one connector.

peerNamespace.description: Namespace of the ingress connector's pods (DNS-1123 label).

peerAppName.description: app.kubernetes.io/name label of the ingress connector's pods.

peerInstance.description: app.kubernetes.io/instance label of the ingress connector's pods. Required and non-empty: the peer namespace holds several connectors publishing one app name, and this label is the fact that picks out the one that fronts this site. A blank or absent value fails validation instead of rendering a policy open to all of them.
